No, next month's box won't be the Collector one. Changes made on or after the 25th apply to the box after next month's. Next month's box was already billed on the 25th at your current plan's price, so it will ship as your current plan.

You can still switch now from "Account" > "Subscriptions". Collector ($49/month, medium or rare plant in a 6-inch pot) would start with the following month's box, which is charged on the 25th of the month before it. There's no fee or minimum term for changing plans.
